name: Overclock
description: A rogue maintenance drone clears a locked-down server facility, floor by floor. One hit kills both ways: shove, grab what the sentries drop, throw it, slam doors on them, and reboot in an instant when it goes wrong.
controls: WASD/arrows move, mouse or right stick aims. Left click/J/Space attack (unarmed: shove, then finish), right click/K throw, E pick up, R reboot the floor, P pause, M mute. Menus: mouse, arrows + Enter, or D-pad + A. Remap keys with the controls panel.

achievements.name: Swing Shift
achievements.description: Take down a sentry while it is still dazed from a door you slammed into it.

achievements.name: Spanner in the Works
achievements.description: Stun a sentry with a thrown wrench.

achievements.name: Hands-On
achievements.description: Clear a floor without picking up a single weapon.

achievements.name: Zero Downtime
achievements.description: Earn an S grade on any floor.

achievements.name: Facility Offline
achievements.description: Clear all four floors in a single run.
